# Summary of Work History Blurb

Jane Doe blends two decades of delivery with a recent pivot to AI-native building. Since 2014 at Cairenes Solutions he has shipped products by directing AI rather than hand-coding — a 10+ open-source lineage (github.com/janedoe) including addypin.com, ownsub.com, late.fyi, and signedreply.com, plus libraries like knowless (passwordless login, live across three products), bare-suite (agent runtime), wearehere (privacy extension), and sawt (Arabic audiobook TTS). Earlier consulting and telecom work spanned distributed contractors across South Asia and US/EU, Agile enablement, and Tier-1 telephony strategy. At Liberty Global (2024–2025) he built unified Jira/PowerBI dashboards across six EU markets, surfaced defect and quality metrics, and installed lightweight governance between Liberty Global and its MSPs. At Meta (2022–2023) he scaled academic researcher onboarding and became the privacy-compliance SME. At Cognizant he modernized a dormant monolith to microservices in three months, and across Vodafone (2005–2014) he expanded roaming coverage from 100 to 190 countries, doubling rollout capacity and generating EGP 12M+ in new revenue.

# Professional Skills

Jane's toolkit lines up directly with an Applied AI Architect role. On the JD's core ask — hands-on building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production — he ships generative and agentic AI products and prototypes without an engineering team, using AI-assisted development, prompt engineering, and rapid low-code/no-code automation. His open-source work is production-grade: knowless runs passwordless login across three live products, and bare-suite provides an agent runtime and context-engineering spine. He pairs builder credibility with consulting and delivery: AI adoption and enablement, change management, program and project management, product operations, and requirements and data analysis — the trusted-advisor muscle the role needs to translate startup requirements into technical solutions. Tooling spans Jira (Structure, Dashboards), Confluence, PowerBI, and Google Suite, with demonstrated release-quality, defect-density, and MTTR reporting. Domains cover telecom/roaming, social media, consulting, systems thinking, and emerging-tech research in AI and cognitive science, plus light privacy and regulatory compliance. Notably, the resume does not evidence Python proficiency, named LLM frameworks, or a competitive technical-sales track record — gaps to address against the JD.

# Soft Skills

Jane's soft skills are grounded in distributed, cross-cultural leadership. At Vodafone he managed 15+ team members across the US, Switzerland, India, Poland, Romania, Hungary, and Luxembourg, earning a reputation for fair, clear leadership and extracting quality work by understanding constraints, cultural differences, and autonomous decision-making. He led distributed contractors across South Asia and US/EU with clear requirements and autonomy, and ran Agile/Scrum enablement for engineering cohorts. His builder-first mindset shows sunk-cost discipline, MVP focus, and minimalism — ship the few features that carry the product, cut the rest — matching the JD's do-more-with-less ethos. He made invisible systems visible within four months at Liberty Global and escalated ten cadence gaps to a VP, evidencing influence and accountability. At Meta he trained teams on SafeGuards and FTC consent requirements and built frameworks that anticipated regulatory change. He travels comfortably across sites and cultures, aligning with the role's customer-site and conference demands, and is an emerging-tech researcher with a stated passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial.

JANE DOE 
Springfield • +1 555-0100 • jane@example.com
linkedin.com/in/janedoe • github.com/janedoe

AI-Native Builder & Technical Program Leader
I take problems to working products — with AI, by reshuffling the rails people already use (email, maps, git, chat) around the human, not a platform. A 10+ open-source lineage (github.com/janedoe) proves it. Behind it: a decade of enterprise embedded delivery roles, and another decade building my own products. Simple over clever, do more with less — ship the few features that carry the product, cut the rest.
 SKILLS
AI Building: Generative & agentic AI, AI-assisted development (ship prototypes without an engineering team), prompt engineering, rapid prototyping, low-code/no-code automation
Consulting & Delivery: AI adoption & enablement, change management, program & project management, product operations, requirements & data analysis, cross-functional leadership & influence
Tools: Jira (Structure, Dashboards), Confluence, PowerBI, Google Suite
Domains: Telecom/roaming, social media, consulting, systems thinking, emerging-tech research (AI & cognitive science); privacy & regulatory compliance (light)

 PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
CAIRENES SOLUTIONS LLC, Doha, San Francisco, Springfield                         August 2014 – Present
Consultant -  AI-Native Builder · Applied Learning
AI Builder (2025–present): Ship products by directing AI, not hand-coding — a 10+ open-source lineage (github.com/janedoe), each stripped to its 2–3 load-bearing features
Apps: addypin.com (cross-platform map links), ownsub.com (Reddit-style forums), late.fyi (EU train-delay email tracker), signedreply.com (email event tracker + digital notary).
Libraries & tools: knowless (passwordless login, in production across 3 products), bare-suite (agent runtime + context engineering — the spine under multis), wearehere (privacy extension — trims cookie expiry, farbles fingerprinting), sawt (Arabic audiobookTTS).
Explored domains to find the gaps: Worked intentionally across social impact, map localization, roaming, NLP, Agent memory, context engineering. Built pattern recognition for unsolved problems — e.g. Aurora Framework research surfacing reasoning gaps in agentic AI.
Earlier builds & lessons: Sharity MVP (Android/iOS) and early product attempts — wins and failures both taught the method: sunk-cost discipline, MVP focus, and minimalism (ship the few features that carry the product).
Consulting, training & telecom: Led distributed contractors across South Asia and US/EU on clear requirements and autonomy; ran Agile/Scrum enablement for engineering cohorts. Telecom (Tier-1 & regional): facilitated two strategy workshops — roaming growth for Jawwal Palestine under regulatory and geopolitical constraints, and SMS market-entry for a late entrant under DMA and anti-fraud rules.
LIBERTY GLOBAL, Schiphol-Rijk				           September 2024 – December 2025
Technical Project Manager - Mobile, broadband, and entertainment
Made Invisible Systems Visible: Self-taught advanced Jira + PowerBI to build unified dashboards across 6 EU markets. Surfaced defect data, feature completion, and quality metrics from opaque delivery environment. Enabled accountability and data-driven decision-making within 4 months.
Built Release Quality Reporting: Created P1-P4 defect density dashboards, epic delivery tracking per country, and automated monthly MTTR reports for markets. Identified 10 cadence gaps; escalated to VP and prioritized top 5 for improvement roadmap.
Implemented Governance Frameworks: Diagnosed handoff gaps between Liberty Global and consecutive MSP teams. Implemented lightweight governance and change management processes to support continuous delivery and predictability.
META, San Francisco 					                 July 2022 – April 2023
Program Manager - Academic Research
Scaled academic researcher onboarding by systematically researching global data and privacy regulations, building adaptive operational frameworks and compliance strategies in a constantly shifting regulatory landscape.
Became SME researcher onboarding and privacy compliance; trained team on SafeGuards and FTC consent requirements, enabling rapid onboarding across multiple regions.
Researched emerging global data and privacy regulations (DSA, UK GDPR, others), building a flexible framework that anticipated regulatory changes and streamlined FTC audit evidence collection.

COGNIZANT, San Francisco 					             October 2019 – July 2020
Sr. Product Manager - Business Consulting
Resurrected Dormant Platform: Led modernization of internal platform from code repository with minimal documentation within 3 months, converting from Monolithic to microservices architecture, upgrading UI, and migrating to cloud. Coordinated engineering teams through clear product requirements and knowledge transfer across distributed consultants and internal stakeholders.
Scaled Agile Adoption: Trained software bootcamp cohorts on Agile Manifesto through hands-on learning—created Manifesto summary (12 points), designed sprint simulation, and delivered comprehensive Agile onboarding curriculum.

VODAFONE, Cairo, Egypt and Doha, Qatar                           	           January 2005 – July 2014 
Product Operations Manager/Program Manager - Telecommunication | Roaming Innovation
Led roaming coverage expansion from 100 to 190 countries through early trend recognition, internal innovation, and distributed team execution. Doubled annual rollout capacity while adding comprehensive data roaming. Extracted principles from each challenge—cost innovation, team delegation, cross-cultural leadership—applied to subsequent roles.
Scaled Roaming Data Coverage: Recognized iPhone/data adoption trends early (2008), expanded geographic footprint from 100 to 190 countries while doubling annual rollout capacity (190 → 400+ services/year). Added comprehensive data roaming alongside voice. Drove cost reduction through internal innovation and price negotiations rather than vendor dependency. Generated EGP 12M+ in new revenue; reduced customer complaints 80%.
Led Cross-Cultural Teams Without Formal Authority: Managed 15+ distributed team members across US, Switzerland, India, Poland, Romania, Hungary, Luxembourg. Developed a reputation for fair, clear leadership. Extracted quality work through understanding constraints, cultural differences, and autonomous decision-making. Applied these principles later to consulting and MSP team management.
INFO, EDUCATION AND CREDENTIALS
Bachelor of Science, Computer Science, Egyptian Aviation Academy, Cairo, Egypt
Certifications: Certified Scrum Master, CSM - Certified Scrum Product Owner, CSPO	
Languages: Arabic (Native); English (Fluent)

REFERENCES
John Smith, Academic Research Lead, +1 555-0101, john.smith@example.com
Jane Roe, Program Manager, +1 555-0102, jane.roe@example.com
Robert Lee, Director Connectivity Development, +1 555-0103, robert.lee@example.com

# Applied AI Architect, Startups — Anthropic

Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5406982008
Fetched: 2026-09-12
Location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
Compensation: $240,000 - $315,000 USD

## Role Description

Serve as a technical partner to startup founders and engineers, helping them build
innovative solutions on the Claude Developer Platform. The role combines deep technical
expertise with a builder-first mindset to guide startups through architecture decisions
and successful Claude deployment.

## Responsibilities

- Partner with Account Executives to understand startup requirements, translate them into
  technical solutions, and serve as a trusted advisor throughout Claude adoption
- Win technical evaluations demonstrating Claude's superiority, helping startups develop
  evaluation frameworks for their specific use cases
- Build credibility with founders and engineering teams by understanding build patterns and
  guiding architectural decisions
- Gather insights on Claude usage patterns and emerging deployment approaches; deliver
  feedback to Product and Engineering teams
- Travel to customer sites, startup events, and industry conferences for workshops and
  relationship building

## Required Qualifications

- 3+ years in technical customer-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, etc.)
- Experience working with startups or high-growth technology companies
- Strong builder credibility through software engineering or technical founder experience
- Deep technical proficiency building and scaling AI products
- Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production
- Strong technical communication skills
- Track record selling technical products competitively
- Python proficiency and LLM frameworks familiarity
- Passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial
